query:
select push_notifications.id, push_notifications.sent
            from push_notifications where push_notifications.id in (
                select notification_id from activity_push_notifications
                    where activity_id = $1 and id = $2
                union
                select notification_id from purchased_ticket_push_notifications
                    where activity_id = $1 and id = $2
                union
                select notification_id from purchased_ticket_push_notifications
                    where activity_id = $1 and id = $2
            )
            for update of push_notifications
